t: This is Nell Gwynn House, a ten-storey Art Deco residential block on Sloane Avenue in Chelsea. It was completed in 1937 and designed by the architect G. Kay Green, who also built the neighbouring Sloane Avenue Mansions a few years earlier. Green was a Scottish architect whose work after 1918 was mostly in southern England. The building has had some famous residents. The entertainer Sir Bruce Forsyth, whose career spanned over seventy-five years, lived here, and so did Amanda Lear, the French singer, painter, actress and television presenter.
